The Tier-1 evaluation image: the proven omarchy base plus the charly
consequence checks for the live omarchy system — the Class B surface
from UPSTREAM-TEST-TRIAGE.md that the shipped beds do not already
assert. Upstream's shell.d tests mock a binary and assert a CALL
SEQUENCE; these assert the resulting SYSTEM STATE, which is strictly
stronger — it proves the machine, not the call — and needs no
upstream source tree in the guest.

The shipped beds already cover: the base image (check-omarchy-pod),
the desktop (check-omarchy-desktop-vm, 102 checks), the ISO install
(check-omarchy-iso-vm, 57 checks incl. vconsole/mkinitcpio/logind/
locale/chromium-policy). This box adds the remaining Class B
consequences: the migration outcomes (retired-installer-artifacts,
legacy-power-udev-rules, security-fido2). The checks are BUILD-context
(they assert the image's content at charly check box) and idempotent —
no side effects, no upstream source tree needed.
